thread:
mira: Quick alert from our retention scan - found Vault-wrapped blob in archived bucket that decrypts with backup CMK. tagging sec.
jon: path pls
mira: s3://redwood-retain/backups/2023-10/agent_snapshot.kms
tasha: ok. propose: 1) deny Decrypt on CMK alias, 2) provision new CMK and swap alias, 3) create new Vault transit key and rewrap, 4) rotate service principals that had decrypt perms.
ops-oncall: freezing writes to that prefix, enabling object logs to secure-audit. scheduling 20m maintenance window at 02:30 UTC.
jon: i'll pull CloudTrail and S3 logs now. initial grep shows two Decrypts this week from ci-runner-03 and one from partner-ingest. exporting events.
sec-bot: matched playbook: keystore-contain. recommended steps posted.
mira: jon, open infra PR to rotate CMK alias. tasha, can you run Vault rewrap and remove partner grant?
jon: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/957 - creates replacement CMK and swaps alias.
tasha: Vault commands i'll run: `vault write -f transit/keys/backup-v2` then `vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@agent_snapshot.kms key=backup-v2`. will revoke partner grant after rewrap.
ops-oncall: maintenance complete; CMK alias swapped and old key disabled pending scheduled-destroy.
jon: CI roles rotated; pipelines rekeyed.
tasha: rewrap done, partner grant removed, audit-forwarder to SIEM enabled.
mira: drafting short incident note and customer-facing blurb. no confirmed exfil so far. will run RBAC sweep next week and file postmortem. :thumbsup:
